metadata.name: UnitContracts
metadata.description: Guides > Unit contracts. Dedicated page for `unitContracts` and `jsonui-test generate unit-stubs`, the third declaration surface after branchContracts and the test files. Eight sections: what the spec carries (the SET of cases, not the body, with the upstream measurement that decided that split), the declaration shape (target / cases / name / intent / optional platforms, unstated meaning every platform the project builds), what jui.config.json must supply (unitTestsDir per platform, testModule for iOS, testPackage for Android, and NOT CHECKED when a directory is undeclared), the generation contract (marker region, failing stubs, append-only and idempotent, nothing ever removed including undeclared cases and files whose markers the author deleted), the three drift kinds MISSING / UNDECLARED / NEVER RUNS with their denominators, the iOS test_ prefix and the two narrowings of the NEVER RUNS scan, the misspelled-key aggregate PROBLEM, and what a name-comparison cannot tell you. ~10-min read.

uiVariables.description: Three closing cards: branch contracts (the declaration side), branch tests (the other generator), testing (where unit tests sit in the whole test story).

notes: 2026-09-08 - Page created, requested 2026-09-07. Every claim on this page is measured on one fixture built for it — a config declaring all three faces with unitTestsDir plus testModule and testPackage, and one spec declaring five cases with one scoped to ios. Generation was measured in the order that reaches the append path — four cases generated, one body hand-written inside the markers, then a fifth case declared: the run converges on run 1, keeps the hand-written body on all three faces, and runs 2-5 are byte-identical no-ops at exit 0. A first probe generated the file fresh with every case already declared, so nothing was ever missing and that path was never entered. The NEVER RUNS narrowing for Swift local functions is measured the same way: one file with `func poll()` inside a test_-prefixed method draws no NEVER RUNS. Section 8 states what the mechanism does not give, because the page otherwise reads as though a green `--check` were a statement about the tests rather than about their names.

2026-09-25 — section_declare_body: unitContracts also lives in the app contracts spec (type app_contracts_spec), where it is required because apiOutcomeRules names its cases in verifiedBy (validate refuses a rules-only file with `Required field 'unitContracts' is missing`). Measured: `generate unit-stubs --check` counts a case declared only there — '1 case(s) declared across 1 spec file(s) scanned (1 spec file(s) carrying a unitContracts block)' — with jui.config.json's platforms given as an object. With platforms given as a list, which contracts coverage accepts, generate unit-stubs raised AttributeError; that is reported upstream rather than documented here.

2026-09-25 — with platforms written as a list, generate unit-stubs --check reports each platform as NOT CHECKED, naming the list shape as the reason ('which has no place for unitTestsDir'). Measured on the same fixture.
2026-09-25 — unitContracts in the app contracts spec is required only beside apiOutcomeRules. Measured: a harnessConditions-only app spec passes; an apiOutcomeRules file without unitContracts fails.
